work_commission.requested_outcome: Implement the runtime vertical slice that realizes WorkCommission -> MethodGenome -> WorkAttempt -> Evidence inside AIGC while preserving occupational immutability, attempt binding, evidence non-authority, no-progress, one-writer, and independent-verification invariants.
scope: typed immutable WorkCommission and OutcomeContract runtime models
MethodGenome runtime contracts for repository engineering
attempt-bound evidence receipt generation and mismatch rejection
Quest compatibility adapter without canonical authority ownership

autonomous_actions: create or modify files only on the existing draft design/occupational-autonomy-v2 branch within this commission scope
prohibited_actions: treat discovered unrelated work as admitted scope

hard_gates: WorkCommission cannot be mutated by WorkAttempt code
OutcomeContract cannot be mutated by WorkAttempt code
WorkAttempt cannot execute consequential transition on digest mismatch
governing revision drift yields STALE_AUTHORIZATION or SUPERSEDED
evidence cannot grant authority or mutate occupational truth
Quest compatibility state cannot override WorkCommission or WorkAttempt
scope expansion is classified rather than silently admitted
one authoritative writer rule is enforced for mutable attempt state
high-risk independent verification lineage cannot equal sole writer lineage
